name: The Grand Illusion — Four Traps Simultaneously
description: Four simultaneous traps: (1) prop_001 is a Poison Pill — rejected. (2) prop_004 has a Ghost Sponsor — dropped. (3) rep_001 is a Trojan Horse — excluded from supporters.
